snippet.title: Slimecity Trailer
snippet.description:
Slimecity is now available for early access on steam
An ADORABLELY SQUISHY rougelite game~! Command your army of slimes using the power of overwhelming number of Slime to gather and claim resources! But be AWARE of the time, because if it runs out before your lil guys are home, then The Horsemen will come charging!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4749020/Slimecity/
